services.name: Sail Reaper
services.desc: Cyrus McCormick invented the grain reaper in 1831 when he was 22 years old and his invention dramatically changed food production around the world. It represented the first major advance in grain-harvesting technology since the scythe came along to supplement the sickle. Farmers have only a small window - 10 to 14 days or so - in which to harvest their grain for the year. With a sickle, a person could harvest about half an acre of grain in a day. In one of his first field exhibitions of the reaper, McCormick harvested six acres in an afternoon.
